fields.objection: Unity in the scored factors does not close material, bond, peel, residual-stress or thin-wall validation.
fields.evidence: The reconstruction retains 345 MPa tensile-as-compression, historical 379.2 MPa endpoint, typical core values, 10 MPa scarf, r/t=300 tube local rule and ideal composite action. A pin-ended Euler screen is 8.675 at the filed Be O5 point, but is not a full frame test.
fields.proposed_fix: Keep an explicit unscored-mode/load-case ledger and ground formed-gauge compression, core at lines, scarf/bond/peel and imperfect thin tubes at representative boundaries. Do not convert the conditional mass-added point into a hull qualification.
fields.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed
